aum.raw: KRW 1 trillion target over 2020-2027 (Fund 1: KRW 513.3bn; Fund 2: KRW 500bn)

strategy.thesis: Government-led fund-of-funds, jointly capitalized by Korea's major financial holding companies and banks plus KOSCOM and d.camp, that selects and commits to sub-fund managers (위탁운용사) so they form blind and project funds investing at least 60% into fintech startups, from early-stage through scale-up and overseas expansion.

notable_investments.outcome: IPO (KOSDAQ 2024, via Korea Investment Partners sub-fund)

summary.en: Korea's government-led fintech fund-of-funds, established Dec 2019 and operated via Korea Growth Investment Corp (한국성장금융). It pools capital from major banks/financial holding companies (KB, NH, Shinhan, Woori, Hana, BNK, DGB), KOSCOM and d.camp, then commits to selected VC/accelerator sub-fund managers that build fintech-focused funds. Fund 1 (2020-2023) raised KRW 513.3bn and supplied KRW 282.4bn to 85 fintech startups; Fund 2 (2024-2027) targets KRW 500bn with Naver Financial and Kakao Pay added as anchor LPs, bringing the program to ~KRW 1tn over eight years.
summary.local: 금융위원회 주도로 2019년 12월 설립된 핀테크 전용 재간접펀드(Fund of Funds)로, 한국성장금융투자운용이 운용한다. KB·NH·신한·우리·하나·BNK·DGB 등 금융기관과 코스콤, 디캠프가 출자하여 모펀드를 조성하고, 위탁운용사를 선정해 핀테크 자펀드를 결성하도록 한다. 1호('20~'23)는 총 5,133억원을 조성해 85개 핀테크 스타트업에 2,824억원을 공급했고, 2호('24~'27)는 5,000억원 규모로 네이버파이낸셜·카카오페이가 출자기관으로 참여했다.

summary.en: Plux Ventures (플럭스벤처스, English brand 'Flux Ventures') is a Seoul boutique VC established December 2021 and registered as a startup-investment company in January 2022 by Bae Sangchul, a former Mirae Asset / Samsung asset-management fund manager and Samsung Venture Investment fintech examiner. Within a quarter of registering it was selected as a Korea Growth Finance blind-fund manager and co-formed a KRW 30bn fintech innovation fund with Mirae Asset Venture Investment, with at least 60% earmarked for fintech and a focus on growth-stage companies.

strategy.thesis: Korea's largest independent VC; runs a dedicated fintech vehicle as a Fintech Innovation Fund sub-fund manager, the first GP in the program to take a fintech portfolio company public.

summary.en: Korea Investment Partners, founded 1986 and Korea's largest independent VC (~KRW 2.9tn AUM), was selected as a Fintech Innovation Fund sub-fund manager in April 2020 and formed the KRW 24bn 'Korea Investment Fintech Innovation Fund' in July 2020. It invested in core-banking-platform maker Bankware Global, which listed on KOSDAQ in Aug 2024 — the first fintech portfolio company across the program's GPs to IPO.

summary.en: iAccel is the startup-investment division (est. 2014, investing since 2016) of KOSDAQ-listed Infobank, operating as an accelerator and TIPS operator. In 2022 it was selected to run a KRW 100억 'Infobank Fintech Innovation Fund 1' (backed by d.camp and Korea Growth Finance under the Fintech Innovation Fund) plus a KRW 175억 early-stage fund, for KRW 275억 combined; its total AUM reached ~KRW 1,100억 by Feb 2025. The fintech fund targets early-stage fintech-tech companies and d.camp-affiliated firms.

summary.en: Shinhan Future's Lab, launched in 2015, is Korea's first financial-sector fintech accelerator, run by Shinhan Financial Group with group affiliates (including Shinhan Venture Investment) acting as mentors/investors. It has supported 516 startups, invested KRW 1,470억 cumulatively, produced 345 collaboration cases and 29 'baby unicorns,' and expanded to Vietnam in 2016. Cohort 11 (2025) admitted 31 companies, with investment driven via a KRW 1,000억 group venture fund.

summary.en: Hanwha DreamPlus 63, opened October 2016 by Hanwha Life, is Korea's largest fintech incubation center, occupying the entire 3,074㎡ fourth floor of the 63 Building in Seoul (described as the world's largest single-floor fintech center). It selected 11 startups initially, pairing each with dedicated support staff and legal/accounting/tax/IP consulting, building partnerships with financial firms including Hanwha Life and offering global expansion via Hanwha's network and access to US/UK/Singapore/Israel VCs.
summary.local: 한화생명이 2016년 10월 출범한 국내 최대 핀테크 육성센터로, 서울 63빌딩 4층 전체(3,074㎡)를 사용하며 단일 층 기준 세계 최대 규모로 소개된다. 초기 11개 스타트업을 선발해 전담 지원인력과 법률·회계·세무·IP 컨설팅을 제공하고, 한화생명 등 금융사와의 파트너십 및 미국·영국·싱가포르·이스라엘 VC 연계와 글로벌 진출을 지원한다.

strategy.thesis: KEB Hana Bank's fintech accelerator (described as a bank-industry first in 2015), offering infrastructure, mentoring, investment, legal/tax/security support and global expansion to fintech startups.

summary.en: Hana 1Q Agile Lab is KEB Hana Bank's fintech accelerator, launched June 2015 and described as a Korean bank-industry first. It provides infrastructure, mentoring, investment, and legal/tax/security/global-expansion support. As of 2018 it had supported 44 startups, with cohort 6 (selected March 2018) admitting 13 companies.

summary.en: NH Fintech Innovation Center is NH Nonghyup Bank's fintech support program, providing office space, patent/investment linkage and a financial-API testbed. It operated Korea's first bank open-API testbed (2015) and introduced P2P-specific APIs (2017).
